launchCore: village hub spawn and full-heal return
large 440x440 combat zones with distinct themes
third-zone boss and fifth-zone final boss
village chief quests with scaling gold/xp rewards
five weapon tiers and five armor tiers
level scaling: max HP +10 and attack +10

gameDescriptionKo: 마을에서 장비와 퀘스트를 준비하고 5개의 포탈 사냥터를 돌파하는 협동 RPG. AI 동료와 파티를 맺고 보스와 던전을 공략해 성장해.
gameDescriptionEn: A co-op RPG built around five portal zones. Gear up in town, recruit AI party members, hunt monsters, clear bosses, and grow stronger together.
robloxTitleEnglish: [5 PORTALS] Five Portal RPG: Dungeon Party
robloxDescriptionKorean: 마을에서 퀘스트와 장비를 준비하고 AI 동료와 4인 파티를 꾸려 5개의 포탈 사냥터를 정복해. 3번째와 5번째 지역에는 보스가 기다리는 3D 액션 RPG.
robloxDescriptionEnglish: Build a four-member party, gear up in the village, and conquer five portal zones in a 3D action RPG with AI companions and bosses.
